title: maint.event.v1{kind=maint_pause}
description: Phase 8 §8.10 — broadcast pause for self-maintenance agents. Each maint.* agent that is paused stops emitting decisions until a `maint_resume` arrives or `ttl_s` elapses. `target='all'` pauses every maint.* agent; otherwise an agent id.

ttl_s.description: Auto-resume after this many seconds; defaults to cfg.maint_pause_default_ttl_s.
